title: Differentiation under the integral sign along the translations y ↦ sv + y
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) (M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, ξ = R.orient), ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n), v ∈ ℝ^P and t ∈ ℝ. For s ∈ ℝ put G(s) := R.action(y ↦ ω(s·v + y)) = ∫_M θ(y)·ξ(y)(ω(sv + y)) dHⁿ(y). Then G has derivative R.action(y ↦ Dω(t·v + y)[v]) at t (HasDerivAt), where Dω(z)[u] = fderiv ℝ ω z u.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (v : Euclid P) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => R.action (fun y => (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (s • v + y))) (R.action (fun y => fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t • v + y) v)) t
